purpose: Advance plan evidence from catalog identity to checksum-bound registration only when legal local bytes, scale/frame metadata and independent residual checks exist.
truth_rules: remote URL is not source-byte custody
source bytes require local path + computed SHA-256
rights gates precede acquisition and registration
plate scale is not a coordinate frame
registration requires control and holdout residuals
no job may promote geometry automatically
failed network transfer is recorded as an acquisition failure, never as missing source evidence
remote page rendering is not original-byte custody
remote plate scale may support acquisition/readiness metadata but not pixel registration
provider-displayed file metadata is a remote fingerprint, not a cryptographic checksum
local import must compute SHA-256 from the exact bytes actually received
Plate VI pixel landmarks remain null until a checksum-bound local render exists
landmark roles and coordinates freeze before the first archaeological fit
